title: 第1728章得知真相李文轩的崩溃第1727章明经第一许观澜大章
slug: 我最强毒士女帝直呼活阎王
lines: 而另一边。
李文轩站在人群里，脸色一点点的白了。
不是王家的王腾，而是许观澜。
寒门？
他原本还想着，若第一是王家的王腾，或者是某个隐世名门，某个他不知晓的世家天才，那也罢了。
可现在第一是许观澜，一个他此前从未听过的寒门！
这就完全不一样了。
江南李氏最耀眼的年轻子弟，被一个入京时身上不足二两银的寒门书生压在了下面。
这句话传出去，比“李文轩明经第二”本身还要刺耳。
这就不是荣耀了，而是……耻辱！
莫大的耻辱！
王景行也傻了，满脸震惊。
“许观澜？”
“他谁啊？”
“他怎么就第一了？不该是李兄吗？”
李心月看着远处被人群包围的许观澜，又看了看一旁道心破碎的李文轩，脸色也有些复杂。
而也就在这时。
榜台上，张平再次敲锣。
咚！
锣声骤然压下底下喧闹的人群。
“肃静！”
众人这才勉强安静下来。
张平拿出一卷明黄诏令，声音冷冽。
“陛下有旨。”
“六科取仕以糊名阅卷，御前终审，乃是先定名次，后拆姓名，只为了公正透明！”
“但为了免除天下士林的疑议，自今日起，各科一甲、二甲试卷，皆张贴于各科榜侧。”
“明经科许观澜、李文轩两卷，另由大乾报、直言报誊印刊出。”
“凡有不服者，可据卷而辩。”
“但不得空口污蔑朝廷取士不公。”
“违令者，重惩！”
轰！
这一道旨意落下，贡院外再次震动。
“公布试卷？”
“连一甲二甲的卷子都贴出来？”
“这是让天下人自己看？”
“但也是，许观澜只是一介寒门，却压过了李文轩和林照野，这太不可思议了！”
众人一阵议论纷纷。
礼部官吏很快搬出早已誊抄好的卷子，开始一张张的贴在榜侧。
先是其他五科，最后才是明经科。
最中间的位置，赫然并列贴着两份卷子。
众人见状，立刻涌上前去。
有人先看李文轩那份，不禁发出一阵赞叹。
“好文章！”
content_en:
And the other side.
Li Wenxuan stood in the crowd, his face turning pale.
It's not Wang Teng from the Wang family, but Xu Guanlan.
Poor family?
He originally thought that if the first one was Wang Teng of the Wang family, or some hidden famous family, some genius from a family that he didn't know about, then that would be fine.
But now the number one is Xu Guanlan, from a humble family that he has never heard of before!
This is completely different.
The most dazzling young disciple of the Li family in Jiangnan was overshadowed by a poor scholar with less than two taels of silver when he entered the capital.
When this sentence spreads, it is even more harsh than "Li Wenxuan Ming Jing Second" itself.
This is not glory, but... shame!
What a shame!
Wang Jingxing was also dumbfounded, his face full of shock.
"No..."
"Xu Guanlan?"
"Who is he?"
"Why is he number one? Shouldn't it be Brother Li?"
Li Xinyue looked at Xu Guanlan, who was surrounded by a crowd in the distance, and then at Li Wenxuan, who was heartbroken, with a complicated expression on her face.
And that's when.
On the standing stage, Zhang Ping struck the gong again.
Boom!
The sound of the gong suddenly suppressed the noisy crowd below.
"Quiet!"
Everyone then reluctantly became quiet.
Zhang Ping took out a volume of Minghuang imperial edicts with a cold voice.
"Your Majesty has a decree."
"The candidates for the six subjects are judged by hiding their names. The final review before the imperial court is to determine the ranking first and then remove the names, just for the sake of fairness and transparency!"
"But in order to avoid the suspicion of scholars all over the world, starting from today, the first-A and second-A examination papers of each subject will be posted on the side of each subject list."
"The Ming Dynasty's classics were published in two volumes by Guanlan and Li Wenxuan, and were copied and published by Daqian Bao and Zhiyan Bao."
"Anyone who is dissatisfied can argue based on the records."
"But you must not slander the imperial court unfairly in selecting scholars."
"Those who disobey orders will be severely punished!"
Boom!
After this decree fell, the outside of Gongyuan was shaken again.
"Announce the test papers?"
"Even the first- and second-grade papers are posted?"
"Is this for the world to see for themselves?"
"But yes, Xu Guanlan is just from a humble family, but he has surpassed Li Wenxuan and Lin Zhaoye. This is incredible!"
Everyone was talking about it.
The officials of the Ministry of Rites quickly took out the copied papers and began to post them one by one on the side of the list.
The other five subjects come first, and the Ming Jing subject comes last.
In the middle position, there are two papers posted side by side.
When everyone saw this, they immediately rushed forward.
Some people looked at Li Wenxuan's part first and couldn't help but let out a burst of admiration.
“Great article!”
